data.name: Prosenjit
data.gender_notes: Prosenjit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prosenjit means one who has complete mastery over his senses and emotions. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prosana' which means 'sense' and 'jit' which means 'mastery'. The name Prosenjit carries the meaning “Master of the senses” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Bengali. Parents who choose Prosenjit usually hope their child will grow to embody master of the senses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prosenjit is a name of Lord Shiva, who is known to have mastered his senses and emotions and is often depicted as the 'Adiyogi' or the first guru. The name signifies a person who has achieved inner peace and tranquility by mastering his senses and emotions.
data.etymology: Prosenjit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Master of the senses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prosenjit total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
